headline: Cat Frazier, Whose Retro GIFs Celebrated a Weirder Internet, Dies at 35
context: She found a future in the internet’s past with a Tumblr blog of animated texts, a revolt against the clean minimalism of contemporary design aesthetics.

sources.name: The New York Times
